The FCC could integrate the RCDD requirement into its proposed consultant registration framework to ensure that consultants performing covered ICT design services have current credentials, minimizing administrative burdens and advancing program integrity objectives.

The FCC's proposed changes to the E-Rate program aim to improve transparency and accountability in the design and implementation of ICT infrastructure supported by E-Rate funds. The proposed changes include requiring E-Rate consultants to hold a current BICSI Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) credential, establishing individual CRNs, and mandating annual mandatory E-Rate and anti-fraud training.
